name: NVIDIA and OpenAI
line: NVIDIA intends up to $100B and committed $30B; OpenAI plans 10 GW of NVIDIA systems.
explanation: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100B (letter of intent), provides $30B and guarantees up to $105B of OpenAI's Ohio leases, and OpenAI commits to deploy at least 10 GW of NVIDIA systems.
